(
Posting a song
Three steps, Song, Royalties and Review, with no step counter. The page structure is on the Text sheet.
Song takes four required things: the audio, an instrumental, a vocals file and a title. Lyrics are not required. The instrumental and vocals are required because Karaoke and Study need them; separating them automatically comes later. Next uploads the files and checks the audio for a match: Uploading, then Checking, then either Royalties or Matched, which names the song and offers Replace audio.
Royalties has the remix cut and the earnings split, which starts as You 100%. The collaborator sheet only finds a person by handle or wallet; a result is added with half of what You hold, and shares are edited in the list.
After Post there is one centred state on the same page, not a card in the feed: processing, published, failed, or waiting for review.
To draw: the collaborator sheet and the after-Post states on desktop.
Desktop: the same steps as the card in the main column
